aboutHero.title: We follow Kenya's public money so it cannot move in the dark.
aboutHero.description: Budget Ndio Story was founded by young Kenyans to dismantle the culture of budget secrecy. We track KSh 4.82 Trillion in national and county spending, transforming opaque fiscal policy into forensic investigations, viral media, and citizen accountability.

aboutCharter.title: Our Charter of Integrity.
aboutCharter.description: When challenging power and tracking public billions, accuracy is our armor. We hold ourselves to forensic journalistic standards.
aboutCharter.anchorDescription: Rooted in Article 201 (Principles of Public Finance) and Article 35 (Access to Information) of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010.

principles.title: Zero Partisan Bias
principles.description: We follow the public money, not political factions. Our loyalty is strictly to Article 201 of the Constitution of Kenya and the Kenyan taxpayer.

principles.title: Primary Source Verification
principles.description: Every data point is cross-verified against official documents from the National Treasury, OCOB, CRA, Auditor General, and parliamentary Hansards.

principles.title: Open-Source Civic Intelligence
principles.description: All simplified data models, scorecards, and learning modules are published free of charge. No paywalls between citizens and public information.

principles.title: Double-Impact Commercial Ethics
principles.description: BNS Studios charges fair market rates to external institutions for creative productions, reinvesting operating surplus into grassroots watchdog operations.

aboutNarrative.title: From street protests to 365-day institutional oversight.
paragraphs: In June 2024, millions of young Kenyans took to the streets to reject punitive tax proposals in the Finance Bill. It was an unprecedented turning point in East African civic history.

As the teargas cleared, a deeper realization took hold among our founders: protesting after an appropriation bill is gazetted is 12 months too late. Once a budget line is passed by Parliament, the public money is already committed to contractor accounts.
Budget Ndio Story was founded to dismantle the culture of budget secrecy: intervening upstream from the first drafting sprint in August to final disbursement in June.

quote.text: Protesting after a bill is gazetted is too late. Citizens must master the budget cycle 12 months in advance - before the money is stolen or misallocated.
quote.author: BNS Founding Assembly

whatWeDo.title: We turn complex budgets into civic action.

steps.title: Decode
